window_world.name: Window of the World
window_world.price_text: ≈ CNY 200–240 adult; check on the day
window_world.hours: Daily roughly 09:00–22:00; check on the day
window_world.tip: A park of scaled world landmarks; go late afternoon to catch the evening light show.

ping_an.name: Ping An International Finance Centre
ping_an.price_text: ≈ CNY 150–250 observation deck; check on the day
ping_an.hours: Observation deck usually daytime to evening; check on the day
ping_an.tip: One of Shenzhen's tallest towers; book the observation deck online and go on a clear day.

folk_village.name: China Folk Culture Village
folk_village.price_text: ≈ CNY 180–220; often bundled with Splendid China
folk_village.hours: Daily roughly 09:00–21:00; check on the day
folk_village.tip: Ethnic-minority villages, shows and costumes; check the show times at the gate.

happy_valley.name: Happy Valley (Shenzhen)
happy_valley.price_text: ≈ CNY 200–260 day ticket; check on the day
happy_valley.hours: Daily roughly 09:30–21:00; check on the day
happy_valley.tip: Theme park with big coasters; weekdays are quieter and some rides close in rain.

heytea.name: Hey Tea
heytea.tip: Shenzhen-born tea chain; order the cheese-topped fruit tea and expect a queue at peak hours.

hk_disneyland.name: Hong Kong Disneyland
hk_disneyland.price_text: ≈ HKD 600–800 one-day ticket; pay in HKD, check on the day
hk_disneyland.tip: Across the border in Hong Kong; you need a valid visa or entry permit and a border crossing.

wetland_park.name: Hong Kong Wetland Park
wetland_park.price_text: ≈ HKD 30 adult; pay in HKD, check on the day
wetland_park.hours: Closed some weekdays; usually 10:00–17:00, check on the day
wetland_park.tip: Birdwatching and boardwalks in Hong Kong's New Territories; bring binoculars and check opening days.

ma_wan.name: Ma Wan Park
ma_wan.hours: Park usually daytime; check on the day
ma_wan.tip: Island park in Hong Kong with harbour views; combine with a walk to the Noah's Ark area.

minsk_world.name: Minsk World (closed)
minsk_world.price_text: Closed; do not plan a visit
minsk_world.tip: The aircraft-carrier attraction is closed, so skip it and check local news before any trip.

naixue.name: Naixue (Nayuki)
naixue.tip: Shenzhen tea and bakery chain; try a fruit tea with a soft bread, good for a quick break.

oct_east.name: OCT East
oct_east.hours: Daily roughly 09:30–18:00; check on the day
oct_east.tip: Resort park in the hills east of the city; allow a full day and check transport options.

snoopys_world.name: Snoopy's World
snoopys_world.price_text: Free rooftop area; some rides charge
snoopys_world.tip: Free Snoopy-themed rooftop at a Sha Tin mall in Hong Kong; good with kids, check ride prices.

splendid_china.name: Splendid China
splendid_china.price_text: ≈ CNY 180–220; often bundled with Folk Culture Village
splendid_china.hours: Daily roughly 09:00–18:00; check on the day
splendid_china.tip: Miniature versions of Chinese landmarks; combine with China Folk Culture Village next door.

dafen.name: Dafen Oil Painting Village
dafen.price_text: Free to walk; paintings and workshops cost extra
dafen.tip: Neighbourhood of art studios and copy-painters; wander the lanes and watch artists at work.

lianhuashan.name: Lianhuashan Park
lianhuashan.hours: Park usually 06:00–23:00; check on the day
lianhuashan.tip: Hilltop park with a city skyline view; walk up for sunset and the Deng Xiaoping statue.

shekou_market.name: Shekou seafood market and food streets
shekou_market.price_text: ≈ CNY 50–150 per person depending on seafood
shekou_market.hours: Market mornings; restaurants into late evening
shekou_market.tip: Pick seafood and have a nearby restaurant cook it; agree the price first.

seaworld.name: Sea World plaza walk
seaworld.price_text: Free to walk; food and drinks extra
seaworld.hours: Plaza and bars usually into late evening
seaworld.tip: Shekou waterfront plaza ringed by bars and restaurants; easy evening stroll near the ferry port.

nanshan_walk.name: Nantou Ancient Town walk
nanshan_walk.hours: Streets always open; shops daytime to evening
nanshan_walk.tip: Old lanes with temples, snacks and small shops; go on foot and try street food.

shenzhen_bay.name: Shenzhen Bay Park promenade
shenzhen_bay.tip: Long waterfront path with views across to Hong Kong; rent a bike or walk at sunset.

ping_an_mall.name: Ping An Finance Center mall food hall
ping_an_mall.tip: Handy indoor food stop under the tower; good for a quick lunch before the observation deck.

border_tour.name: Hong Kong day trip from Shenzhen
border_tour.price_text: ≈ CNY 200–500 plus transport; check visa rules
border_tour.hours: Border crossings usually early to late; check on the day
border_tour.tip: Cross at a land port with your passport and visa ready; allow extra time at peak weekends.
